dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple interlocking and isolated 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp, high-contrast transitions from dark background pixels to thin, bright-intensity perimeters with jagged, irregular edge geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity white punctate spots lacking internal gradients, predominantly clustered in the posterior-lateral region of the frame.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-lateral annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, while smaller posterior ring structures create a series of interconnected irregular polygonal spatial relationships.
